limitations: Required scoped suites passed; this is not a full-repository test claim.
PowerShell orchestration uses mocked process/transport boundaries; ZIP extraction uses inert artifact-boundary inputs, not deployment-valid binary manifests.
The inherited wait/envelope/audit/report-hash seam executes real Python code with a mocked owned process and synthetic identity/provenance records.
Hosted network mechanisms use TEST_ONLY owned loopback children; contained is only a fixture phase, and the ordinary null-SID pair is not AppContainer SID equality.
Production parent is compiled and invoked only with invalid CLI. A valid production network CLI and nonadmin production profile are not dynamically tested.
Injected token/SID/pre-resume refusal controls are not actual failing ResumeThread API calls.
The timeout receiver observed four frames; no valid child report was observed, so those frames are not a native accepted-send count.
The new QPC interface was exercised on hosted Windows; no actual executor startup or full guest descendant path has been observed.
Runtime remains OFF. No descendant AppContainer inheritance, packet absence, DNS/broker, Linux-equivalence or product-acceptance claim is made.
Strict original Stage0 and all prior inconclusive history remain unchanged. No raw identity, PID, SID, paths, nonces, tuples, PCAP or private bundle is archived.

Delayed-start checks observe the same QPC frequency and remaining >2s before delay, then 0<remaining<=2s before launch; the native wrapper subsequently refuses child creation. This is not full native initial admission or a hard syscall timing guarantee.
